title: Claude expands design capabilities with six free #claudeai #designautomation #opendesigntools
description: Claude gained six free open-source skills that transform it into a full design team. These include adding motion to components, generating layouts and styles, auditing code against Vercel's design standards, creating full design boards from rough ideas, extracting exact style details from websites, and converting screenshots into functional websites. These capabilities streamline the design process by automating complex tasks while maintaining creative control. They represent a significant innovation in AI-powered design tools, enhancing productivity and ensuring design consistency across projects. The availability of these open-source skills lowers the barrier for designers and developers to produce high-quality digital products faster and with fewer resources.
